description: What would a chicken do in the South Pole? Well, freeze to death probably.... After escaping from a travelling circus, a trio of penguins and a baby polar bear show up at the farm. Toto makes a promise to his ailing mother that he will help them return to their natural habitat, despite the fact that the freezing temperatures they will confront at the end of their epic journey are not exactly ideal conditions for a bunch of farmyard chickens. This movie brings Toto’s saga to a close and is by far the most exciting, fun-filled and dramatic instalment in the series.
